title: Scrum Master
description:
Want to be a bswifter At bswift we ve been transforming benefits administration since 1996, making it simpler, smarter, and more human. Our state-of-the-art, cloud-based technology and services empower employees to understand, manage, and love their benefits. From downtown Chicago, and remotely across the country, we serve thousands of companies and millions of people nationwide, reducing administrative burdens and freeing HR teams to focus on creating thriving, people-first workplaces. We re looking for motivated and goal-driven individuals who share our passion for delivering excellence and creating solutions that make a difference. The reward is a fun, flexible and creative environment with ample opportunity for professional and personal growth. If you love the bswift values of pursue excellence, embrace accountability, deliver superior service, and be a great place to work, we want to hear from you! Position Summary 
 You will join the team as a Scrum Master, responsible for guiding and enabling multiple Agile teams at bswift. This role is responsible for driving delivery excellence, strengthening Agile practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement across cross-functional product teams. You ll work closely with software developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and performant services that enable seamless user experiences. Responsibilities 
 Lead and coach multiple Scrum teams to ensure predictable, high-quality, end to-end delivery. 
 Facilitate all Agile ceremonies and uphold Scrum principles, bswift standards, and delivery discipline. 
 Collaborate with Product Owners on backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and alignment with business priorities. 
 Proactively identify, escalate, and remove impediments to maintain smooth execution. 
 Coordinate cross-team dependencies, risks, and release planning while ensuring transparent communication with stakeholders. 
 Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and best practices to strengthen team performance and delivery. 
 Mentor and develop team members and junior Scrum Masters to foster a high-performance, self-organizing culture. 
 Ensure teams meet quality standards, maintain accurate Agile tracking systems, and deliver according to definition of done. 
 Support organizational initiatives including PI Planning, capacity planning, governance activities, and process optimization. Knowledge, Education, and Experience 
 
 Education : 
 Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience). Experience : 
 2-5 years of hands-on experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams. 
 Proven success leading multiple Agile teams in a complex, scaled environment. 
 Strong experience in backlog management, sprint planning, release coordination, and cross-team delivery. 
 Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication across distributed teams. 
 Experience with Agile transformation, continuous improvement initiatives, and delivery governance. 
 Familiarity with DevOps workflows, release processes, and modern engineering practices. 
 Experience in enterprise SaaS, healthcare, HR tech, or benefits administration domains (preferred). Knowledge & Skills: 
 Deep knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and practical application in real-world teams. 
 Strong skills in facilitation, conflict resolution, coaching, and servant leadership. 
 Hands-on expertise with Agile tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar. 
 Ability to interpret and use delivery metrics to guide decisions and improvements. 
 Understanding of product lifecycles, SDLC, project management fundamentals, and quality standards. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence across teams. Certifications (Preferred): 
 CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or equivalent Agile certifications. Why Join bswift At bswift, we empower our employees to make a meaningful impact, innovate, and grow. Joining our team means stepping into a collaborative and dynamic environment that values creativity, initiative, and a passion for client success. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and values each team member s unique contributions. Benefits of Working at bswift: Comprehensive Health Benefits : Medical, Accidental and Term Life Insurance coverage to support your wellness and that of your family. Competitive Compensation : A compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and contributions, including performance-based incentives for most roles. Hybrid work-model: With flexible working hours Retirement Savings Plans : Options like Provident Fund and Gratuity to help you plan for a secure financial future with employer contribution Professional Development : Opportunities for career growth, including training and access to resources to support your career progression. Supportive Culture : A work environment that encourages collaboration, open communication, and creative problem-solving, where your voice and ideas are valued. Employee Wellbeing Initiatives : Programs focused on mental health, financial planning, and wellness resources to help you thrive inside and outside of work. Make an Impact : At bswift, your work directly contributes to transforming how organizations approach benefits administration and client engagement. Join us to be part of an organization that is making a meaningful difference in the lives of our clients and their employees. At bswift, our mission is clear: Become the preeminent benefits administrator through exceptional people, innovative technology, and delighted customers. And our values are at the heart of everything we do to accomplish that mission. We Pursue Excellence, Embrace Accountability, Deliver Superior Service, and strive to Be A Great Place To Work . We take pride in having an engaged, collaborative team that goes the extra mile to get the job done right. bswift has been regularly named one of Chicago s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For , as well as one of the Nation s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For year after year. We offer a fun, flexible, and creative environment where you can grow both professionally and personally. If you have what it takes to join our award-winning culture, we d love to hear from you!

description:
Artificial Intelligence & Engineering AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations. Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions help Deloitte client service teams improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  Position Summary Level: Delivery Management Engineer III As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions. The Scrum Master is a key member of an Agile team, responsible for facilitating the Scrum process, coaching team members in Agile best practices, and ensuring the teams effectiveness in delivering high-quality products. The Scrum Master acts as a servant leader, removing impediments and fostering a collaborative, transparent, and high-performing team environment. Work you’ll do: As a Delivery Management Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for supporting Agile delivery execution, enabling team effectiveness, and helping drive high-quality outcomes across POD-based delivery environments. Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives. Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum, Agile practices, and scaled Agile ways of working to support effective delivery. Remove impediments, manage dependencies, and help resolve delivery risks impacting sprint execution. Support backlog refinement, prioritization, and communication of delivery goals in collaboration with Product Owners and cross-functional stakeholders. Track sprint progress, delivery flow, and quality metrics, while preparing status updates and maintaining Scrum artifacts to promote transparency. The team:  Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM; 2 PM to 11 PM Qualifications Require 6+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile delivery role supporting POD-based delivery models and collaboration across multiple PODs, including Scrum of Scrums. Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification. Experience applying Scrum and scaled Agile frameworks, including SAFe, in software delivery environments. Experience with software development life cycle, project planning and estimation, risk identification, and capacity and dependency management. Experience using Agile project management tools, including Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, or Rally, and building dashboards to report delivery metrics. Experience coaching Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams on Agile practices, Lean delivery practices, and product delivery tools. Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university, or equivalent degree. Preferred: SAFe Agilist certification. Experience working with cross-functional teams in enterprise-scale delivery environments. Experience tracking sprint plan, definition of done, quality, and delivery flow metrics. Experience supporting backlog refinement and backlog management with Product Owners. Experience with version control systems, including GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release management processes. Experience using objectives and key results and key performance indicators to measure Agile team performance.
